warnings: Scenario results replace the independent full-allocation estimates in evidence. Each scenario applies the same specified basis-point split to every supplied veNFT; rounding is per veNFT. This is a stress assumption, not a forecast or guaranteed range. Zero observed competing weight stays zero under proportional stress; it does not rule out new voters. Changes on incomplete subtotals are incomplete, and percent decrease is null for a zero baseline.
